title: A New Neighbor
paragraphs: Sepasang suami istri muda pindah ke rumah sebelah keluarga Ahmad. Ia memperhatikan truk pindahan sejenak, lalu memutuskan bahwa ini saat yang tepat untuk memperkenalkan diri dan menyambut mereka ke lingkungan dengan baik.

Ia mengambil beberapa buah segar dari kebunnya dan membawanya ke pintu rumah mereka. "Selamat datang di jalan kami," kata Ahmad sambil tersenyum ramah. Sang suami terkejut senang dan berterima kasih atas sikap penuh perhatian itu.

Mereka berdiri dan mengobrol beberapa menit di depan pintu. Ahmad mengetahui bahwa pasangan itu baru saja pindah dari kota lain karena pekerjaan. Ia menawarkan untuk mengantar mereka berkeliling pasar dan masjid terdekat suatu saat nanti.

Selama beberapa minggu berikutnya, kedua keluarga itu perlahan menjadi akrab. Ahmad menyadari bahwa satu tindakan sambutan sederhana bisa membuka jalan menuju persahabatan yang langgeng antar tetangga yang sebelumnya mungkin tetap menjadi orang asing.
answerKey: A young couple moves into the house next door to Ahmad's family. He watches the moving truck for a while, then decides that it is a good time to introduce himself and welcome them to the neighborhood properly. He picks some fresh fruit from his garden and brings it to their door. "Welcome to our street," Ahmad says with a friendly smile. The husband is pleasantly surprised and thanks him warmly for such a thoughtful gesture. They stand and talk for several minutes at the doorstep. Ahmad learns that the couple recently moved from another city for work. He offers to show them around the local market and the nearest mosque sometime soon. Over the following weeks, the two families slowly become close. Ahmad realizes that a simple act of welcome can open the door to a lasting friendship between neighbors who might otherwise have remained complete strangers.
